currentParagraphText: “I guess we’ll find out,” Jake shrugged. “If Miranda and the others need help, they can just contact us then. With the veil around our universe weakening, it will also be easier for us to teleport back and forth, so even if bad actors try to stop us from returning, I seriously doubt they’re capable.”
